query:
-- Verificar TODOS os 14 sem arId contra a inadimplência
SELECT cp.id as cp_id, cp.empresa as cp_empresa, cp.valor as cp_valor, cp.vencimento as cp_venc,
  ar.id as ar_id, ar.cliente as ar_cliente, ar.valorLiquido as ar_vliq, ar.valorRecebidoLiquido as ar_vrec,
  (CAST(ar.valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(12,2)) - CAST(COALESCE(ar.valorRecebidoLiquido, '0') AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as ar_areceber,
  LEFT(ar.vencimentoData,10) as ar_venc
FROM cobranca_planilha cp
LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON (
  UPPER(TRIM(ar.cliente)) = UPPER(TRIM(cp.empresa))
  AND LEFT(ar.vencimentoData, 10) = cp.vencimento
  AND ar.estado = 'EMITIDO'
  AND ar.tipo IN ('TITULO', 'RECEITA', 'ADIANTAMENTO')
)
WHERE cp.ar_id IS NULL
ORDER BY cp.id;
